title: 通过转移复杂度刻画游戏世界：提出过渡复杂度剖面（TCP）
summary: 论文提出过渡复杂度剖面（TCP），用一组可复现的指标刻画游戏环境或数据集的转移核，包括单步分支、交互不确定性、时空依赖跨度，并附带参考分布和测量预算，呼吁作为GWM和RL论文的标准元数据。
summary_en: The paper proposes Transition Complexity Profile (TCP), a set of reproducible metrics characterizing game environments' transition kernels, including branching, interaction uncertainty, and dependency spans, with reference distributions and measurement budgets, advocating TCP as standard benchmark metadata.
